english.title: Use a vehicle on road in London as a PHV without a PHV licence - London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), as a private hire vehicle on a road in London, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when a private hire vehicle licence was not in force for that vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(1), (2) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes:
(i) See also H6430 for the similar offence wording in relation to the operator of a private hire vehicle.
(ii) It is a defence for the driver to show that he exercised all due diligence to prevent the vehicle being used in contravention of section 6(4).
(iii) Section 6(6) provides that In this section "private hire vehicle licence" means:-

(a) except where paragraph (b) or (c) applies, a London private hire vehicle licence;
(b) if the vehicle is in use for the purposes of a hiring the booking for which was accepted outside London in a controlled district, a licence under section 48 of the 1976 Act issued by the council for that district; and (c) if the vehicle is in use for the purposes of a hiring the booking for which was accepted in Scotland, a licence under section 10 of the Civic Government (Scotland) Act 1982.

and for the purposes of paragraph (b) or (c) it is immaterial that the booking in question is a sub-contracted booking.
